verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-1 fail-open is corrected: the collaborator permission adapter now accepts only string values in the complete documented permission domain, raises on missing, null, non-string, and unknown values, records those failures for the deletion-side conservative inversion, and preserves valid non-maintainer permissions as completed negative results. The new end-to-end rows exercise each malformed-value class through the production entrypoint and include quiet positive and negative controls, so the fix is non-vacuous. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, or security issue in the diff.
